description.value: The Madras Diaries is a South Indian and Indo-Chinese restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, drawing on the cuisines of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh with dishes like Chettinadu chicken, Mandhi biryani, and an extensive dosa menu. Clay pot preparations and regional specialties such as Kozhi Kuzambu and Gongura Lamb distinguish it from generic Indian restaurants. Online ordering with a quick pickup window makes it a practical fueling stop for cyclists passing through East Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (14 spaces) at 32m; wall_loops (12 spaces, covered) at 43m; stands (4 spaces) at 50m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional with an active online ordering system, confirming the business is open. The website confirms the address (1097 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC V5V3C7) and provides a phone number (+1 604-707-8177) absent from OSM. The menu clearly lists numerous vegetarian items (Dal Fry, Palak Paneer, Vegetable Biriyani, Vegetable Stew, etc.) and the site explicitly offers pickup/takeout ordering. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-tourism amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone +1 604-707-8177 sourced from website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, independently operated restaurant with takeout and a broad vegetarian menu on a major Vancouver cycling corridor; a useful Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated Vegetable Curries section (Dal Fry, Vegetable Stew, Palak Paneer, Mutter Paneer, Dal Makhni, etc.), Vegetable Biriyani, Plain Dosa, and multiple vegetable-based dosa and appetizer options
